note: S14b.3 THE inverse-pair tripwire: demote∘promote == identity BYTE-EXACT on the WHOLE store, on a NON-canonically-ordered pre-existing .promotions list. The store starts with a pre-existing promotion id:7 (the right cell {600,0,400,1000}, empty interior — harmless). promote the LEFT column [1:0:0,1:0:1] APPENDS id:8 (_next_promotion_id = 1+max(7) = 8) to the .promotions TAIL, touching .segments/.bindings/.off_top/id:7 NOT AT ALL. demote(id:8) FILTERS that record by id, leaving [id:7] byte-identical to the input. Neither op re-sorts, so identity holds on ANY ordering — STRONGER than insert/remove (which mutate one segment's id field): promote/demote mutate ONLY the .promotions list. Asserts {promote_ok, demote_ok, identity:true, valid_after_promote:true} — valid_rec(derive_nested) is green throughout the round-trip (both promotions derive a valid nested tree).
